burro failures · show what failed, where, and whether it is NEW or SEEN

Usage: burro failures [id] [--max-lines 40]

  --max-lines n    most lines to print, the last says what is left (default 40)

Example
  burro failures r42 --max-lines 100

Exit codes  0 passed · 1 tests failed · 2 server problem or runner died
            3 still running · 4 bad flags or unknown run
